intent: New public human-facing surfaces should avoid CoDry+ by presenting a meaningful hero graphic or rich-media experiment while maintaining utility, source integrity, and accessibility.

required_for_eligible_surfaces: one useful, original-or-rights-cleared hero illustration, interactive source graph, animation, visualization or embedded rich-media experience
one meaningful user action, not decorative theater

cowet.relation: CoDry+ useful density is preserved below the rich invitation; CoGlam+/CoWow+/CoJaz+ and CoGayAsAPeachBaby+ are opt-in creative voices, not universal visual treatment

audio_policy.after_opt_in: Volume may ramp gently with scroll within a visible, bounded cap; scrolling does not bypass mute/no-audio preference
controls: pause or silence at any time
persist 'no audio' preference only if user deliberately selects it, and respect it
audio_policy.visibility: Pause/suspend on hidden tab where applicable
audio_policy.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; do not infer audio preference solely from it
audio_policy.accessibility: Non-audio equivalent; avoid masking screen readers; meet WCAG audio control and contrast; no flashing content
audio_policy.privacy: Do not infer hearing impairment, neurotype, or other sensitive traits from audio-off choice; do not track individual preference externally
audio_policy.user_label: CoAudioFkOff+ = accessible no-audio choice; in production use ordinary 'Sound off' wording

experiments.hypothesis: visual source-bound hero improves comprehension and voluntary exploration
experiments.falsifier: a plain equivalent performs as well or better

experiments.hypothesis: opt-in, quiet scroll-responsive ambiance is enjoyable without disruption
experiments.falsifier: higher annoyance or degraded comprehension compared with silent default

experiments.hypothesis: retrofit high-value pages before applying sweeping redesign
experiments.falsifier: retrofit breaks content or increases recovery friction
